caveat: Captions carry ASR spellings; matcher must expect near-misses, same as the WNT/TBPN pattern this was copied from. anchor_note: video content offset 0 anchored to the video PUBLISH timestamp (yt-dlp timestamp field, second precision), not a day-only upload_date. For a pre-recorded VOD (not a live broadcast), this is the methodologically correct anchor: a trader cannot react to content before the video is public, so publish_ts + content_offset is the right proxy for 'when could a listener have possibly heard this' -- the quantity a pack-lag measurement actually needs, distinct from WNT/MLB/WNBA where the anchor is a real-world live-broadcast/game-action instant.
